title: Dataset of EEG recordings of pediatric patients with epilepsy based on the 10-20 system
description: This dataset contains scalp EEG recordings with high-frequency oscillation (HFO) markings from 30 pediatric patients with focal or generalized epilepsy. The first three hours of sleep EEG were recorded and processed to detect ripple-band (80-250 Hz) oscillations in bipolar channels using an automated, clinically validated HFO detector. Derived data include selected N3 sleep intervals with candidate HFO event annotations, aimed at investigating age-related effects on non-invasive epileptogenicity biomarkers.
methods_description: Three hours of sleep EEG were recorded per subject using the 10-20 system. Sleep stages were identified from annotations, and 5-minute intervals from N3 sleep were extracted. Bipolar referencing was applied using nearest-neighbour channel pairs, yielding 52 bipolar channels. An automated, clinically validated HFO detector was used to identify ripple-band (80-250 Hz) oscillations in these intervals.
